prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents our client in connection with the parking lot collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Kindly provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including claim files, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, vehicle data, surveillance footage, and repair estimates. Any destruction or alteration of such materials could prejudice our client's claim. We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this letter and your cooperation in resolving the claim.
